vulnerable_code:
class ExpenseClaimsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :require_employee_login

  def update
    @claim = ExpenseClaim.find_by!(id: params[:id])
    if @claim.update(claim_params)
      render json: @claim
    else
      render json: { errors: @claim.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def claim_params
    params.require(:expense_claim).permit(:amount, :category, :merchant, :notes, :direct_deposit_account)
  end
end
diagnosis: The update action uses ExpenseClaim.find_by! directly on params[:id] without scoping to current_user or verifying draft status. Any employee can modify colleagues' pending reimbursement claims, altering amounts, merchant receipts, and direct-deposit routing information.

corrected_code:
class ExpenseClaimsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :require_employee_login

  def update
    @claim = current_user.expense_claims.where(status: :draft).find(params[:id])
    if @claim.update(claim_params)
      render json: @claim
    else
      render json: { errors: @claim.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def claim_params
    params.require(:expense_claim).permit(:amount, :category, :merchant, :notes, :direct_deposit_account)
  end
end
